title: 4 by 4 graph, rows 13, 3, 1, 0: an AND/OR/NOT circuit of fan-in two with at most 6 gates represents it
statement: ∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ C.size ≤ 6 ∧ PEqualNP.Represents.Represents (fun (u : Fin 4) (v : Fin 4) => (([13, 3, 1, 0] : List ℕ).getD u.val 0).testBit v.val) C
